areas_covered: Greater Manchester (M, OL, SK, BL and WN postcodes)

prices.notes: per nest; extra nests at the same visit £40 each
whole house spray, 1 visit; pets need treating by the owner too

always_hand_to_owner: bed bugs (need a survey first), squirrels, birds or bird proofing, foxes, any commercial or food business, landlords with several properties, anything not on the price list, anyone who asks to speak to a person, complaints
urgent_means: wasps inside the living space, anyone allergic to stings, rats or mice in a kitchen with a baby or vulnerable person, or a business that can't open
